+def _feasible_radii(centers):
+    """Largest mutually feasible radii for fixed centers (walls + pairwise)."""
+    r = [min(x, y, 1 - x, 1 - y) for x, y in centers]
+    m = len(centers)
+    for _ in range(30):
+        changed = False
+        for a in range(m):
+            for b in range(a + 1, m):
+                dx = centers[a][0] - centers[b][0]
+                dy = centers[a][1] - centers[b][1]
+                d = math.hypot(dx, dy)
+                s = r[a] + r[b]
+                if s > d:
+                    t = d / s
+                    r[a] *= t
+                    r[b] *= t
+                    changed = True
+        if not changed:
+            break
+    return r
+

+def _score(centers):
+    r = _feasible_radii(centers)
+    return sum(r), r
